items.name: debpalash/VoiceStudio
items.one_liner: Open-source local voice cloning and dubbing, privacy-first ElevenLabs alternative
items.pain_point: Expensive cloud TTS APIs, privacy concerns, latency issues — indie devs, creators, and enterprises building voice products need self-hosted control and cost savings
app_ideas: Local podcast studio: solo podcaster clones own voice, generates episodes from outlines in 646 languages
YouTube dubbing tool: creators upload video, auto-translate/dub to target languages with voice cloning
Accessibility audiobook converter: publishers/authors convert text to audiobooks using cloned voices
items.monetization: Freemium with GPU compute caps + B2B API wrapper for dev studios + vertical SaaS tiers for content creators
items.why_now: 46% weekly star growth signals massive demand for privacy-compliant, cost-effective voice AI as ElevenLabs pricing drives users to self-hosted alternatives

items.name: affaan-m/ECC
